verse.verse_1: By those who range themselves in ranks,
verse.verse_2: And so are strong in repelling (evil),
verse.verse_3: And thus proclaim the Message (of Allah)!
verse.verse_4: Verily, verily, your Allah is one!-
verse.verse_5: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all between them, and Lord of every point at the rising of the sun!
verse.verse_6: We have indeed decked the lower heaven with beauty (in) the stars,-
verse.verse_7: (For beauty) and for guard against all obstinate rebellious evil spirits,
verse.verse_8: (So) they should not strain their ears in the direction of the Exalted Assembly but be cast away from every side,
verse.verse_9: Repulsed, for they are under a perpetual penalty,
verse.verse_10: Except such as snatch away something by stealth, and they are pursued by a flaming fire, of piercing brightness.
verse.verse_11: Just ask their opinion: are they the more difficult to create, or the (other) beings We have created? Them have We created out of a sticky clay!
verse.verse_12: Truly dost thou marvel, while they ridicule,
verse.verse_13: And, when they are admonished, pay no heed,-
verse.verse_14: And, when they see a Sign, turn it to mockery,
verse.verse_15: And say, "This is nothing but evident sorcery!
verse.verse_16: "What! when we die, and become dust and bones, shall we (then) be raised up (again)
verse.verse_18: Say thou: "Yea, and ye shall then be humiliated (on account of your evil)."
verse.verse_19: Then it will be a single (compelling) cry; and behold, they will begin to see!
verse.verse_20: They will say, "Ah! Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!"
verse.verse_21: (A voice will say,) "This is the Day of Sorting Out, whose truth ye (once) denied!"
verse.verse_22: "Bring ye up", it shall be said, "The wrong-doers and their wives, and the things they worshipped-
verse.verse_23: "Besides Allah, and lead them to the Way to the (Fierce) Fire!
verse.verse_24: "But stop them, for they must be asked:
verse.verse_25: "'What is the matter with you that ye help not each other?'"
verse.verse_26: Nay, but that day they shall submit (to Judgment);
verse.verse_27: And they will turn to one another, and question one another.
verse.verse_28: They will say: "It was ye who used to come to us from the right hand (of power and authority)!"
verse.verse_29: They will reply: "Nay, ye yourselves had no Faith!
verse.verse_30: "Nor had we any authority over you. Nay, it was ye who were a people in obstinate rebellion!
verse.verse_31: "So now has been proved true, against us, the word of our Lord that we shall indeed (have to) taste (the punishment of our sins).
verse.verse_32: "We led you astray: for truly we were ourselves astray."
verse.verse_33: Truly, that Day, they will (all) share in the Penalty.
verse.verse_34: Verily that is how We shall deal with Sinners.
verse.verse_35: For they, when they were told that there is no god except Allah, would puff themselves up with Pride,
verse.verse_36: And say: "What! shall we give up our gods for the sake of a Poet possessed?"
verse.verse_37: Nay! he has come with the (very) Truth, and he confirms (the Message of) the messengers (before him).
verse.verse_38: Ye shall indeed taste of the Grievous Penalty;-
verse.verse_39: But it will be no more than the retribution of (the Evil) that ye have wrought;-
verse.verse_40: But the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah,-
verse.verse_41: For them is a Sustenance determined,
verse.verse_42: Fruits (Delights); and they (shall enjoy) honour and dignity,
verse.verse_44: Facing each other on Thrones (of Dignity):
verse.verse_45: Round will be passed to them a Cup from a clear-flowing fountain,
verse.verse_46: Crystal-white, of a taste delicious to those who drink (thereof),
verse.verse_47: Free from headiness; nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.
verse.verse_48: And besides them will be chaste women, restraining their glances, with big eyes (of wonder and beauty).
verse.verse_49: As if they were (delicate) eggs closely guarded.
verse.verse_50: Then they will turn to one another and question one another.
verse.verse_51: One of them will start the talk and say: "I had an intimate companion (on the earth),
verse.verse_52: "Who used to say, 'what! art thou amongst those who bear witness to the Truth (of the Message)?
verse.verse_53: "'When we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed receive rewards and punishments?'"
verse.verse_54: (A voice) said: "Would ye like to look down?"
verse.verse_55: He looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.
verse.verse_56: He said: "By Allah! thou wast little short of bringing me to perdition!
verse.verse_57: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I should certainly have been among those brought (there)!
verse.verse_58: "Is it (the case) that we shall not die,
verse.verse_59: "Except our first death, and that we shall not be punished?"
verse.verse_60: Verily this is the supreme achievement!
verse.verse_61: For the like of this let all strive, who wish to strive.
verse.verse_62: Is that the better entertainment or the Tree of Zaqqum?
verse.verse_63: For We have truly made it (as) a trial for the wrong-doers.
verse.verse_64: For it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-Fire:
verse.verse_65: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of devils:
verse.verse_66: Truly they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.
verse.verse_67: Then on top of that they will be given a mixture made of boiling water.
verse.verse_68: Then shall their return be to the (Blazing) Fire.
verse.verse_69: Truly they found their fathers on the wrong Path;
verse.verse_70: So they (too) were rushed down on their footsteps!
verse.verse_71: And truly before them, many of the ancients went astray;-
verse.verse_72: But We sent aforetime, among them, (messengers) to admonish them;-
verse.verse_73: Then see what was the end of those who were admonished (but heeded not),-
verse.verse_74: Except the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah.
verse.verse_75: (In the days of old), Noah cried to Us, and We are the best to hear prayer.
verse.verse_76: And We delivered him and his people from the Great Calamity,
verse.verse_77: And made his progeny to endure (on this earth);
verse.verse_78: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations to come in later times:
verse.verse_79: "Peace and salutation to Noah among the nations!"
verse.verse_80: Thus indeed do we reward those who do right.
verse.verse_81: For he was one of our believing Servants.
verse.verse_82: Then the rest we overwhelmed in the Flood.
verse.verse_83: Verily among those who followed his Way was Abraham.
verse.verse_84: Behold! he approached his Lord with a sound heart.
verse.verse_85: Behold! he said to his father and to his people, "What is that which ye worship?
verse.verse_86: "Is it a falsehood- gods other than Allah- that ye desire?
verse.verse_87: "Then what is your idea about the Lord of the worlds?"
verse.verse_88: Then did he cast a glance at the Stars.
verse.verse_89: And he said, "I am indeed sick (at heart)!"
verse.verse_90: So they turned away from him, and departed.
verse.verse_91: Then did he turn to their gods and said, "will ye not eat (of the offerings before you)?...
verse.verse_92: "What is the matter with you that ye speak not (intelligently)?"
verse.verse_93: Then did he turn upon them, striking (them) with the right hand.
verse.verse_94: Then came (the worshippers) with hurried steps, and faced (him).
verse.verse_95: He said: "Worship ye that which ye have (yourselves) carved?
verse.verse_96: "But Allah has created you and your handwork!"
verse.verse_97: They said, "Build him a furnace, and throw him into the blazing fire!"
verse.verse_98: (This failing), they then sought a stratagem against him, but We made them the ones most humiliated!
verse.verse_99: He said: "I will go to my Lord! He will surely guide me!
verse.verse_100: "O my Lord! Grant me a righteous (son)!"
verse.verse_101: So We gave him the good news of a boy ready to suffer and forbear.
verse.verse_102: Then, when (the son) reached (the age of) (serious) work with him, he said: "O my son! I see in vision that I offer thee in sacrifice: Now see what is thy view!" (The son) said: "O my father! Do as thou art commanded: thou will find me, if Allah so wills one practising Patience and Constancy!"
verse.verse_103: So when they had both submitted their wills (to Allah), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (for sacrifice),
verse.verse_104: We called out to him "O Abraham!
verse.verse_105: "Thou hast already fulfilled the vision!" - thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
verse.verse_106: For this was obviously a trial-
verse.verse_107: And We ransomed him with a momentous sacrifice:
verse.verse_108: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:
verse.verse_110: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
verse.verse_111: For he was one of our believing Servants.
verse.verse_112: And We gave him the good news of Isaac - a prophet,- one of the Righteous.
verse.verse_113: We blessed him and Isaac: but of their progeny are (some) that do right, and (some) that obviously do wrong, to their own souls.
verse.verse_114: Again (of old) We bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron,
verse.verse_115: And We delivered them and their people from (their) Great Calamity;
verse.verse_116: And We helped them, so they overcame (their troubles);
verse.verse_117: And We gave them the Book which helps to make things clear;
verse.verse_118: And We guided them to the Straight Way.
verse.verse_119: And We left (this blessing) for them among generations (to come) in later times:
verse.verse_120: "Peace and salutation to Moses and Aaron!"
verse.verse_121: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
verse.verse_122: For they were two of our believing Servants.
verse.verse_123: So also was Elias among those sent (by Us).
verse.verse_124: Behold, he said to his people, "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
verse.verse_125: "Will ye call upon Baal and forsake the Best of Creators,-
verse.verse_126: "Allah, your Lord and Cherisher and the Lord and Cherisher of your fathers of old?"
verse.verse_127: But they rejected him, and they will certainly be called up (for punishment),-
verse.verse_128: Except the sincere and devoted Servants of Allah (among them).
verse.verse_129: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:
verse.verse_130: "Peace and salutation to such as Elias!"
verse.verse_131: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
verse.verse_132: For he was one of our believing Servants.
verse.verse_133: So also was Lut among those sent (by Us).
verse.verse_134: Behold, We delivered him and his adherents, all
verse.verse_135: Except an old woman who was among those who lagged behind:
verse.verse_137: Verily, ye pass by their (sites), by day-
verse.verse_138: And by night: will ye not understand?
verse.verse_139: So also was Jonah among those sent (by Us).
verse.verse_140: When he ran away (like a slave from captivity) to the ship (fully) laden,
verse.verse_141: He (agreed to) cast lots, and he was condemned:
verse.verse_142: Then the big Fish did swallow him, and he had done acts worthy of blame.
verse.verse_143: Had it not been that he (repented and) glorified Allah,
verse.verse_144: He would certainly have remained inside the Fish till the Day of Resurrection.
verse.verse_145: But We cast him forth on the naked shore in a state of sickness,
verse.verse_146: And We caused to grow, over him, a spreading plant of the gourd kind.
verse.verse_147: And We sent him (on a mission) to a hundred thousand (men) or more.
verse.verse_148: And they believed; so We permitted them to enjoy (their life) for a while.
verse.verse_149: Now ask them their opinion: Is it that thy Lord has (only) daughters, and they have sons?-
verse.verse_150: Or that We created the angels female, and they are witnesses (thereto)?
verse.verse_151: Is it not that they say, from their own invention,
verse.verse_152: "Allah has begotten children"? but they are liars!
verse.verse_153: Did He (then) choose daughters rather than sons?
verse.verse_154: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
verse.verse_155: Will ye not then receive admonition?
verse.verse_156: Or have ye an authority manifest?
verse.verse_157: Then bring ye your Book (of authority) if ye be truthful!
verse.verse_158: And they have invented a blood-relationship between Him and the Jinns: but the Jinns know (quite well) that they have indeed to appear (before his Judgment-Seat)!
verse.verse_159: Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the things they ascribe (to Him)!
verse.verse_160: Not (so do) the Servants of Allah, sincere and devoted.
verse.verse_161: For, verily, neither ye nor those ye worship-
verse.verse_162: Can lead (any) into temptation concerning Allah,
verse.verse_163: Except such as are (themselves) going to the blazing Fire!
verse.verse_164: (Those ranged in ranks say): "Not one of us but has a place appointed;
verse.verse_165: "And we are verily ranged in ranks (for service);
verse.verse_166: "And we are verily those who declare (Allah's) glory!"
verse.verse_167: And there were those who said,
verse.verse_168: "If only we had had before us a Message from those of old,
verse.verse_169: "We should certainly have been Servants of Allah, sincere (and devoted)!"
verse.verse_170: But (now that the Qur'an has come), they reject it: But soon will they know!
verse.verse_171: Already has Our Word been passed before (this) to our Servants sent (by Us),
verse.verse_172: That they would certainly be assisted,
verse.verse_173: And that Our forces,- they surely must conquer.
verse.verse_174: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
verse.verse_175: And watch them (how they fare), and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
verse.verse_176: Do they wish (indeed) to hurry on our Punishment?
verse.verse_177: But when it descends into the open space before them, evil will be the morning for those who were warned (and heeded not)!
verse.verse_178: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
verse.verse_179: And watch (how they fare) and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
verse.verse_180: Glory to thy Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they ascribe (to Him)!
verse.verse_182: And Praise to Allah, the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds.
